component.name: Mailbox
component.summary: A self-contained IMAP and SMTP client

description.p: One mail client with many faces: this window, a terminal interface, a command line and a local web page, all over the same offline store.

ul.li: A single search field that takes the same query language as the command line
Keyboard triage: archive, delete, snooze and flag without leaving the list
Messages render as sanitized HTML with remote images off until you allow them
Works offline, and sends from an outbox that survives a crash
Updates itself from inside the window

description.p: Fixes the macOS app's update check, which could not reach its release manifest, and gives its notifications the app's own icon.
Keeps the unread and flagged filters inside the folder on screen rather than searching the whole mailbox, and stops a message being skipped when one is read and the next one filed.
Fixes the About pane's update check, which answered with a permission error instead of looking for a new version.
Gives the macOS app the rounded icon and margin the platform expects, and fixes the signing step so the macOS release publishes its packages and update manifest again.
Carries the key the in-app updater checks signatures against, so builds from here on can update themselves where the platform allows it, and keeps the header still while a sync runs.

Fixes a window left open for days becoming unresponsive, opens and saves attachments from the reader, folds a long recipient list instead of letting it push the message off the pane, and publishes the macOS release assets again.
Adds swipe-to-file and wasd triage to the graphical interfaces, lets the macOS build update itself from a signed manifest, and sends macOS notifications as the app so they carry its icon.

Reworks the terminal's panes so the folders and a message preview take turns beside the index, with a header naming what is shown and which keys apply, and offers to fetch a message body that has not been downloaded yet rather than only reporting that it is missing.

Gives the terminal a folder list and a message preview that slide in beside the index, brings the window's keyboard into line with the terminal's and adds undo to it, and adds message filters, drag and drop onto folders, a mail context menu and an about box.
Fixes marking mail read in a multi-account mailbox, syncs when the window opens and in the background, and moves adding an account into the accounts dialog.
Adds OAuth2 sign-in to the hosted client, a keyboard shortcut list, and a build stamp naming the commit each build came from.
Adds macOS packaging, hosted deployment, and mailbox usability improvements.
